<content>
1: // Orbit Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (function () {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // Audio context and simple sound helpers
11:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
12:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
13:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:     osc.start();
24:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
25:   }
26:   function playThrust() { playTone(200, 0.1); }
27:   function playCollision() { playTone(100, 0.4); }
28: 
29:   const planet = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, r: 30 };
30:   const ship = { angle: 0, r: planet.r + 20, speedR: 0, rotSpeed: 0.03, thrust: 0 };
31:   const drones = [];
32:   let gameOver = false;
33: 
34:   // input handling
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
38: 
39:   function spawnDrone() {
40:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
41:     let x, y, vx, vy;
42:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
43:     if (side === 0) { // left
44:       x = -20; y = Math.random() * H; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
45:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
46:       x = W + 20; y = Math.random() * H; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
47:     } else if (side === 2) { // top
48:       x = Math.random() * W; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed;
49:     } else { // bottom
50:       x = Math.random() * W; y = H + 20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed;
51:     }
52:     drones.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 10 });
53:   }
54: 
55:   function update() {
56:     // ship controls
57:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
58:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
59:     const thrusting = keys['ArrowUp'];
60:     if (thrusting) ship.thrust = 0.5; else ship.thrust = 0;
61:     ship.speedR += ship.thrust - 0.02 * ship.speedR; // simple drag
62:     ship.r += ship.speedR;
63:     if (ship.r < planet.r + 10) ship.r = planet.r + 10;
64:     if (ship.r > Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 10) ship.r = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 10;
65:     // play thrust sound when thrusting
66:     if (thrusting) {
67:       // ensure audio context is resumed on interaction
68:       if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
69:       playThrust();
70:     }
71: 
72:     // move drones
73:     for (let d of drones) {
74:       d.x += d.vx; d.y += d.vy;
75:     }
76:     // remove off‑screen drones
77:     for (let i = drones.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const d = drones[i];
79:       if (d.x < -30 || d.x > W + 30 || d.y < -30 || d.y > H + 30) drones.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // collisions
83:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
84:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
85:     const distToPlanet = Math.hypot(shipX - planet.x, shipY - planet.y);
86:     if (distToPlanet < planet.r + 5) {
87:       if (!gameOver) playCollision();
88:       gameOver = true;
89:     }
90:     for (const d of drones) {
91:       if (Math.hypot(shipX - d.x, shipY - d.y) < d.r + 5) {
92:         if (!gameOver) playCollision();
93:         gameOver = true;
94:         break;
95:       }
96:     }
97: 
98:     // draw background
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
100:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
101:     // stars
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
103:     for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
104:       const sx = Math.random() * W;
105:       const sy = Math.random() * H;
106:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
107:     }
108:     // planet with gradient
109:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
110:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.3,
111:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r
112:     );
113:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
114:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
115:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
116:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
117:     // ship as triangle
118:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
119:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
120:     const shipSize = 8;
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
122:     ctx.beginPath();
123:     ctx.moveTo(
124:       shipX + Math.cos(ship.angle) * shipSize,
125:       shipY + Math.sin(ship.angle) * shipSize
126:     );
127:     ctx.lineTo(
128:       shipX + Math.cos(ship.angle + Math.PI * 0.8) * shipSize,
129:       shipY + Math.sin(ship.angle + Math.PI * 0.8) * shipSize
130:     );
131:     ctx.lineTo(
132:       shipX + Math.cos(ship.angle - Math.PI * 0.8) * shipSize,
133:       shipY + Math.sin(ship.angle - Math.PI * 0.8) * shipSize
134:     );
135:     ctx.closePath();
136:     ctx.fill();
137:     // drones with subtle gradient
138:     for (const d of drones) {
139:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(d.x, d.y, d.r * 0.3, d.x, d.y, d.r);
140:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
141:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#a00');
142:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
143:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
144:     }
145:     if (gameOver) {
146:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
147:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
148:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
150:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
151:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
152:     }
153:   }
154: 
155:   function loop() {
156:     if (!gameOver) {
157:       if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnDrone();
158:       update();
159:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160:     } else {
161:       update(); // final draw
162:     }
163:   }
164:   loop();
165: })();

(End of file - total 165 lines)
</content>
